title: Challenge to White Fang
writer: Alberto Silvestri, Roberto Gianviti, Lucio Fulci
actors: Franco Nero, Virna Lisi, John Steiner
plot: Sequel to Lucio Fulci's first 'White Fang' has the wolf-dog once again trying to stop the villainous Beauty Smith from claiming a recently discovered gold mine in 1899 Yukon, Canada.
